ranked.headline: Histology models and atlases map single-cell states across tissue and tumour space
ranked.summary: H&E-to-molecular foundation models, spatial co-localisation statistics and expanded tumour microenvironment atlases appeared together in November 2026.

ranked.headline: Histology, spots and unpaired omics are translated into cell-resolved molecular profiles
ranked.summary: GeneFlow, SCOPE, st2sc and SpOTr infer cell-resolved expression or protein from coarser or cheaper inputs such as H&E images or spot-level spatial data.

ranked.headline: Frozen protein language models get dynamics, structure and ligand context grafted on
ranked.summary: New work adapts frozen PLM embeddings with molecular dynamics, 3D structure, geometry and chemical modalities for variant, PTM, kinetics and affinity prediction.

ranked.headline: Large catalogues and modular decompositions map microbial mobile and accessory gene content
ranked.summary: New resources span a planetary MGE catalogue, a population-scale gut phage catalogue, and modular decomposition of the S. aureus accessory pangenome.

ranked.headline: New reference genomes and multi-omics databases expand non-model marine and flatworm genomics
ranked.summary: Two new de novo assemblies (seep tubeworm, red seaweed) and NAR database releases for planarians and stony corals appeared within days of each other.

ranked.headline: Models and benchmarks quantify how regulatory and metabolic states shift across conditions and stress
ranked.summary: New mechanistic models, spatial causal inference and cross-dataset benchmarks test how reliably condition-dependent regulation can be inferred and predicted.

ranked.headline: Association tests and risk models are being extended to handle latent structure, relatedness, and variant classes
ranked.summary: New methods jointly model rare and common variants, relatives, and multi-phenotype interactions, alongside summary-statistic PRS and multi-tissue eQTL gene prioritization.

ranked.headline: Genomic analysis software is rebuilt for scale, with new storage formats and precomputed resources
ranked.summary: New preprints rewrite deepTools, MAUDE and per-base storage for cohort scale, while database updates add precomputed variant and atlas resources.

ranked.headline: Binder design expands to multi-variant, atom-level and latent-space objectives with new pose and interface assessment
ranked.summary: New preprints extend binder design beyond single-target affinity, alongside tools for data generation and for assessing glycan poses and protein interfaces.

ranked.headline: Long-read data support sample-specific methylation calls and assembly-based variant inference
ranked.summary: New long-read methods span CpG likelihood modeling, local-assembly SV calling and signal-level assembly, extending resolution of sample-specific epigenetic and structural variation.

ranked.headline: Harmonized archive metadata and semantic search make public sequencing data findable and reusable
ranked.summary: Three tools released in November 2026 target the bottleneck of locating and reprocessing public omics data across SRA, GEO and INSDC/CNCB archives.

ranked.headline: Preprints stress-test genomic inference: compressibility, epistasis screens, and random marker sets
ranked.summary: Three preprints probe the validity of sequence-based and omics inference, from non-coding DNA compressibility to epistasis calls and random-signature predictivity.

ranked.headline: Cross-cohort and cross-cell-line tests expose instability in siRNA and CRISPRi perturbation predictions
ranked.summary: New preprints pair siRNA potency models with external benchmarks and show CRISPRi rankings and knockdown transfer depend on cohort and cell-line context.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate domain tools for modeling, statistics, and prediction, with human review calibrating errors
ranked.summary: Preprints test LLM orchestration of established biological tools, reporting accuracy and review-burden trade-offs in modeling, omics statistics, and complex stoichiometry.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models steered by oracles, constraints and re-decoding for design tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints steer or re-decode pretrained generators with oracles and chemical constraints, spanning RNA, DNA, antibody and conjugate design.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test causal structure learning and surrogate models under latent confounding and sparse data
ranked.summary: New comparisons evaluate causal discovery on kinetic and CRISPR data while inference tools for intractable-likelihood and sparse-data models are consolidated.

ranked.headline: Curated structure and ligand databases add AI-era content and programmatic access
ranked.summary: Four NAR database updates pair expanded structural, ligand and interaction content with APIs, clients and agentic access, easing computational reuse.

ranked.headline: Workflows and databases convert genome and amplicon sequences into taxonomic and functional assignments
ranked.summary: New pipelines and an updated mOTUs database make species assignment, 16S profiling and genome alignment more reproducible and accessible.

ranked.headline: Open MS tools tighten annotation, QC and reuse across lipidomics, metabolomics and proteomics
ranked.summary: Six new MS tools and resources target annotation, quality control and data reuse, with several lowering the barrier for non-programmers.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models are curated, extended in scope, and paired with ML for flux and essentiality prediction
ranked.summary: New preprints extend curated GEMs and ME-models and add ML for essentiality and flux inference, alongside a benchmark of EC number prediction from reaction structures.

ranked.headline: Cell-type-resolved models score noncoding variant effects on regulatory activity
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases and sequence-based variant models now resolve noncoding regulatory effects across brain, blood, and cancer cell states.

ranked.headline: Cross-platform and timing-aware validation reshapes biomedical prediction claims
ranked.summary: Reported biomedical prediction performance depends on validation design, with cross-platform tests exposing drops that same-modality evaluation hides.

ranked.headline: Scalable tools and foundation models reshape molecular evolution inference
ranked.summary: Protein foundation models, GPU covariance-model search and orthology benchmarks are changing how evolutionary inference is scaled and validated.

ranked.headline: Analysis choices and evaluation depth alter reported effects across biological datasets
ranked.summary: Public reanalyses and benchmarks now show that analysis and evaluation choices can create, erase, or reverse reported biological effects.

ranked.headline: Curated multi-species resources for noncoding RNA annotation across diverse organisms
ranked.summary: Cross-species annotation of circular, snoRNA, and bacterial sRNA regulators, alongside genome-scale lncRNA analysis, is building reusable infrastructure for noncoding RNA studies.

ranked.headline: Polymer and coarse-grained models link chromatin loop extrusion to measured dynamics
ranked.summary: Single-molecule-calibrated and atomistic models now quantify cohesin extrusion, chromatin locus dynamics, and megabase-scale DNA ensembles against experimental data.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases map cell abundance and expression variation with age and common eQTLs
ranked.summary: Donor-scale single-nucleus atlases now pair cell abundance, expression, and genetic variation with ageing and Alzheimer's disease across brain regions.

ranked.headline: Long-read assemblies resolve near-complete genomes across plants, parasites and animals
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now yields near-complete assemblies of repetitive and structurally complex genomes, enabling pangenome and trait-level analyses.

ranked.headline: Stress feedback on contractile fibers yields bistability and orthogonal fiber domains
ranked.summary: Recent preprints connect stress feedback and deformability to mechanical structure, now including imaging-calibrated models of wing disc morphogenesis.

ranked.headline: Sequence and structure models assessed for reliability beyond training distributions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints validate biological sequence models on selection, calibration, and homology-controlled benchmarks rather than accuracy alone.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose how sample context and gene selection shape omics prediction accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published benchmark test how sample tissue, compact gene sets and regression choices affect omics-based drug response and clinical prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned models restore detail from noisy cryo-EM, cryo-ET, and fluorescence data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply unsupervised, zero-shot, and fidelity-constrained learning to noisy cryo-EM/ET and multiplexed imaging data.

ranked.headline: Aging-aligned remodeling, cross-species timing, and region-calibrated epigenetic clocks
ranked.summary: Generative and clock-based models now separate aging-aligned change from disease remodeling and recalibrate age estimates across species and populations.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs refine haplotype assignment, germline alleles and ancestry inference
ranked.summary: Graph-aware and k-mer representations are beginning to replace variant calls and linear references in haplotype, germline and ancestry analyses.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics traces gene-family evolution and selection across vertebrates
ranked.summary: Expanded comparative sequence collections, from 1,961 vertebrates to 363 avian genomes, now allow selection and copy-number changes to be tested directly.

ranked.headline: Chromatin contacts link enhancers and promoters to target genes across genomes
ranked.summary: Hi-C and Promoter Capture Hi-C contacts are now used to assign regulatory elements to target genes across conditions and tools.

ranked.headline: Enhanced sampling resolves multimodal binding in CYFIP1-eIF4E and FCP1-Rap74
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and learned latent models now expose multiple binding modes in disordered and large protein complexes.

ranked.headline: Cross-species atlases define conserved primate basal ganglia cell types and organization
ranked.summary: Four multimodal atlases now align human, macaque, marmoset, and mouse basal ganglia cell taxonomies within shared ontologies and spatial reference frames.

ranked.headline: Protein and metabolite language models link molecular features to biological function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply language-model embeddings to brain cell-type protein networks, MS2 spectra, and ontology entity normalization.

ranked.headline: Full-length isoform profiling and platelet RNA-seq methods resolve transcript diversity
ranked.summary: Full-length HiFi sequencing of human left ventricles and purity-aware platelet RNA-seq extend transcriptome annotation to isoforms and low-input cell types.
